title: Painting Amid Chaos
content: One of the biggest challenges of plein-air painting is maintaining focus while unpredictable things happen around you. A park should be a calm, peaceful place to paint, right?This excerpt from "Casein Painting in the Wildcaptures a little of the fun when we painting in Montreal last summer. (Link to watch video on YouTube)Square Phillips, Montreal, casein, 5x8 inchesHave you faced similar challenges?
